The '''Halthor sector''', also known as '''Sector O-1''', was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] near [[Noonian sector/Legends|Noonian sector]].

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was governed by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Gergris]].
